interventions.speaker: CHAIR
interventions.who: the senior urologist who signs the decision
interventions.body: The prognosis is influenced by several factors, including a preoperative PSA of 12 and pathological T3b disease with positive surgical margins and seminal vesicle invasion. The Gleason score was 4+3 (ISUP grade group 3). These findings suggest an elevated risk profile. Countervailing points include the absence of documented lymph node metastasis and no reported lymphovascular invasion. Missing information regarding subsequent postoperative PSA trajectory would significantly impact prognosis assessment. Further data on the post-operative PSA level and its rate of change are necessary to refine risk stratification beyond the current pathological findings. The nodal status was assessed, with no mention of missing sampling. The fixed estimated horizon is 38.08 months. This is a predicted recurrence horizon, not evidence of observed recurrence. The sensitivity range is 30.47–45.70 months; its coverage has not been validated.
